document.title: Gamify Instagram live

source.description_exact: Want more comments and sales during Lives? Turn your audience into contestants with DM-triggered giveaways
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Gamify Instagram live
Want more comments and sales during Lives? Turn your audience into contestants with DM-triggered giveaways
Business value
Boost engagement, grow your list, and make your Lives way less awkward.
How does it work?
Ask people to comment “WIN” or “ME” during your Live. Then auto-DM them something exciting.
